name: AgentRail
description: A local control plane for AI coding agents. Focuses on routing, supervising, and auditing multi-agent work across repos, CI, and self-hosted environments.

name: Polygram
description: AI-native design and coding app to build mobile & web apps. Unlike tools that 'blindly vibe-code from a prompt,' Polygram first understands your intent before generating code/design, combining planning, design, code generation, preview, and GitHub sync.

name: Pixcode
description: A self-hosted control room for AI coding agents. Web UI and desktop/server control room for Claude Code, Cursor CLI, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and OpenCode with multi-agent orchestration, files, shell, Git, API keys, Telegram, notifications, plugins, MCP, and theme customization.
